51243109.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human RXRalpha LBD by ITC

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: The interaction of 28 and the RXRα LBD was studied under cell-free conditions by isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC), where 28 showed high affinity binding with an independent binding constant Kd of 0.095 ± 0.005 μM (Figure S4). Binding was both driven by enthalpic (ΔH = −25 kJ/mol) and entropic shares (ΔS = 49 J/mol K). The minor difference between the Kd and EC50 value may be due to the cellular assay environment where activity is also affected by cell penetration and potential degradation.

(b,c) Selectivity profile of 3 and optimized derivative 28 on 12 nuclear receptors related to RXRs at 30 μM. Although 3 also activates RAR, 28 gained full RXR selectivity. n ≥ 3. (d, e) 28 activated permissive RXR heterodimers with (d) PPAR and (e) LXR in full-length assays showing synergistic effects with the respective partner agonists rosiglitazone (Rosi) and T0901317 (T090); (d) n = 3, (e) n = 4. (f) 28 induced RXR-regulated gene expression (qRT-PCR) of adiponectin (ADIPOQ), angiopoietin-like 4 (ANGPTL4), and apolipoprotein E (APOE) with similar efficacy as bexarotene (1, Bex). n = 4. All values are mean ± SEM; * p < 0.05; ** p < 0.01; *** p < 0.001.
